nome: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II
sintesi: Study ignition, flame growth, flame spread, and extinction limits for solid fuels burning in low-velocity forced flows in microgravita.
risultato_chiave: BASS-II results contribute to the combustion computational models used in the design of fire detection and suppression systems.
fonte_note: [PSI-25 Approach]: wind tunnel installed in Microgravity Science Glovebox... airflow speeds up to 40 cm/s | [NTRS 20150019858, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20150019858]: "Oxygen concentrations in the MSG working volume were varied during the testing from ambient ISS oxygen levels (~ 21% O2) ... down to ~ 14% O2 for very near-limit flames."
note: Flusso min vuoto: la fonte cita solo il massimo di 40 cm/s. DOI da riverificare sul sito PSI. O2 14-21% preso dal paper NTRS 20150019858 (DA VERIFICARE che coincida con BASS-II). Pressione non indicata come condizione di prova (solo 1 atm nel calcolo). Lo stesso paper cita flusso max ~55 cm/s senza restrittori e ~35 cm/s con due restrittori; la scheda PSI dice fino a 40 cm/s: valori diversi, tenuto quello della scheda.

sintesi: Determine how rapidly a large scale fire grows in low-gravity and investigate the low-g flammability limits.
risultato_chiave: Saffire-1 experiments were performed on the Cygnus resupply vehicle after it deberthed from the ISS.
fonte_note: [PSI-98 Approach]: Saffire-I was conducted at an air flow velocity of 20 cm/s
note: Flusso costante a 20 cm/s (min=max). DOI da riverificare sul sito PSI. | Nome ufficiale PSI: Spacecraft Fire Experiment-I (era '...Fire Safety...').

sintesi: Study droplet combustion and extinction characteristics in microgravity to improve fire safety and combustion efficiency.
fonte_note: [PSI-69 Approach]: droplet combustion tests using heptane | [NTRS 20130014061, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/20130014061]: "The ambient oxygen concentration varied from a high value of 30% by volume to as low as 12%"; "at primarily two different ambient pressures (0.7 and 1 atm)".
note: Flusso e pressione non esplicitati nella descrizione: lasciati vuoti. DOI da riverificare sul sito PSI. | Nome corretto: era 'Flame Extinction Experiment' (nome ufficiale NASA PSI). | O2 12-30% e pressione 0.7 e 1 atm dal paper NTRS 20130014061 (gocce di metanolo; DA VERIFICARE che coincida con FLEX). Pressione convertita: 0.7 atm = 10.3 psia, 1 atm = 14.7 psia. Il paper non indica la velocita' del flusso (ambiente quiescente).

sintesi: Evaluate material flammability limits in microgravity using a broader suite of solid materials.
risultato_chiave: Saffire-II tested multiple materials to establish flammability screening protocols.
fonte_note: [PSI-99 Approach]: Saffire-II evaluated PMMA, Lexan and other materials

nome: Structure and Liftoff in Combustion Experiments
sintesi: Examine flame stabilization, liftoff, and blowout limits in laminar jet flames in microgravity.
fonte_note: [PSI-106 Approach]: SLICE investigation on propane jet flames
note: Progetto SLICE non e' tra i valori ammessi: messo 'altro'. Valori numerici assenti. DOI da riverificare.
